title: Amazing Fall Crochet Square Pattern – Rudbeckia Square
author: Veronika Cromwell (Blue Star Crochet)
notes: Pattern starts with 'With yarn A create a magic circle.' (written here as 'Make a magic ring.'). Stated counts printed on their own line after each round were moved onto the round line, with their square brackets written as parentheses. Between-round colour-change lines ('Fasten off, join yarn B...') omitted (colours: A rnds 1,4; B rnds 2,5; C rnds 3 and 6; no change stated for rnds 7-8). Finishing omitted.
